card.name: Spaces and digits before dose numbers
card.fires_on: Spaces, digits and small linking words just before a number in dose or strength text, such as the gap before '2% solution' or the 0 in '0.4 mg'. Also fires in blood-draw descriptions on words like 'moderate' and 'include' that come before pain or risks.

modes.label: Before a number
modes.description: A space or leading digit right before a concentration, strength or lab value.
